dedupe_keys.name: dataset for underground hydrogen storage simulations

description: Shaowen Mao, Alvaro Carbonero and Mohamed Mehana at Los Alamos National Laboratory publish synthetic subsurface-flow fields for machine-learning prediction of underground hydrogen storage. The repository README describes 1,000 simulations, each covering ten years in two-month steps, giving 60,000 training pairs. Inputs are porosity and permeability maps; outputs are pressure in bar and hydrogen saturation on 128-by-128 grids. Zenodo's October 2024 deposit supplies LMDB files free under CC BY 4.0. The README explains key structure and a common initial state; database entry counts include constants and initial records and should not be equated with training-pair counts. Physical cell size, site geography and simulator boundary conditions remain unknown from this metadata review. The dataset supports training and testing surrogate storage simulations, not direct inference of field performance. No related catalogue record explicitly covers it. Files were not downloaded.
